decisions.reason: The aloe vera line is a multi-product range with its own page that fits the core natural skincare offer, so a small firm would keep developing it rather than drop it after two years.
A hyaluronic acid serum is a popular, inexpensive part of a facial range that small-batch production can sustain, though its low website visibility leaves some risk of a range trim.
The cleansing oil was launched in 2024, likely as the replacement for the withdrawn cleansing milk, so the firm would give it time to establish itself in the facial cleansing slot.
